projects.name: Mission Control Expansion Directive

sessions.task: FOUNDATIONAL: Build Mission Statement & Founder Profile into Mission Control
sessions.description: Mission Control must reflect the mission statement, founder profile, founder's long-term objectives, and the family enterprise model. This is the foundational identity layer that all other command layers reference.

sessions.task: FOUNDATIONAL: Model Ownership & Entity Structure (LLCs, LPs, Trusts, Holdings)
sessions.description: Build structured representation of all companies, holding companies, LPs, LLCs, trust relationships, ownership percentages, and property ownership. This is the data backbone for Entity Map, Finance Command, and Risk Command.

sessions.task: FOUNDATIONAL: Define Family Enterprise Model & Generational Planning Framework
sessions.description: Define the structure for how family enterprise stewardship, wealth compounding goals, and generational transfer planning are tracked and managed within Mission Control.

sessions.task: CMD-1: Executive Overview — Top-Level Org Dashboard
sessions.description: Build a top-level dashboard showing the most important metrics, priorities, risks, opportunities, and current actions across the entire organization. Colby should see at a glance: state of business, state of holdings, state of cash/capital, state of active initiatives, state of risk, and highest-leverage next actions.

sessions.task: CMD-2: Entity Map — Companies, Holdings, Trusts & Ownership Visualization
sessions.description: Build a structured and visual map of companies, holdings, LPs, LLCs, trust relationships, ownership percentages, and property ownership. Must show entity relationships, ownership structures, and how assets flow between entities.

sessions.task: CMD-3: Revenue Command — Revenue by Business, Growth Initiatives & Pipeline
sessions.description: Build a view of revenue by business, growth initiatives, pipeline drivers, trends, bottlenecks, and current priorities affecting top-line growth. Track revenue growth initiatives and what is performing vs what is broken.

sessions.task: CMD-4: Expense & Efficiency Command — Vendor Spend, Margin Leakage & Waste Reduction
sessions.description: Build a system for identifying expense categories, vendor spend, inefficiencies, margin leakage, duplicate costs, and opportunities to reduce waste. Support expense reduction initiatives and margin management.

sessions.task: CMD-5: Cash Flow & Finance Command — Position, Forecasts & Obligations
sessions.description: Build a central view for cash position, inflows, outflows, obligations, forecasts, and near-term financial pressure points. Business and personal finance visibility where appropriate. Where capital is going must be clear.

sessions.task: CMD-6: Investing & Capital Allocation Command — Deployment, Returns & Strategy
sessions.description: Build a place to track investment decisions, capital deployment, returns, strategic rationale, ownership value, and future opportunities. Support capital allocation decisions and long-term wealth building.

sessions.task: CMD-7: Operations & Automation Command — Workflows, Delegation & Founder Burden Reduction
sessions.description: Build a view of workflows, automations, delegated tasks, recurring processes, system dependencies, and places where founder involvement can be reduced. Support autonomous operations and reduce founder drag.

sessions.task: CMD-8: Strategic Initiatives Command — Major Goals, Buildouts & Execution Tracking
sessions.description: Build a place for major goals, current buildouts, project execution, blockers, timelines, and outcomes. Track strategic initiatives across the organization with clear visibility into what matters and what is changing.

sessions.task: CMD-9: Risk & Exposure Command — Legal, Financial, Tax & Concentration Risk Monitoring
sessions.description: Build a surface for legal, operational, financial, tax, concentration, and execution risks that need monitoring and mitigation. Surface where risk is building and where leverage can be created.

sessions.task: CMD-10: Memory & Decision Command — Institutional Knowledge, Decision Logs & Directives
sessions.description: Build a persistent record of major decisions, assumptions, directives, structural notes, and institutional knowledge that OpenClaw should preserve and use. This is the organizational memory system.

sessions.task: DESIGN: Build KPI System Across All Businesses & Entities
sessions.description:
USE EXA SEARCH to design and implement KPIs spanning all operating businesses. Agent: Pierce (pulse) - Performance Analyst.

EXA SEARCH QUERIES:
1. "short term rental performance metrics KPIs 2026"
2. "Airbnb RevPAR benchmarks 2026 vacation rental"
3. "vacation rental business KPI dashboard occupancy ADR revenue"
4. "real estate holding company performance metrics"

BRAVE SEARCH QUERIES:
1. "vacation rental KPI benchmarks by market 2026"
2. "short term rental operating metrics industry standards"

EXPECTED DELIVERABLES:
- KPI framework per business: RevPAR, occupancy rate, ADR, revenue per property, guest satisfaction
- Holding company KPIs: NAV, equity growth, cash-on-cash return, cap rate
- Performance benchmarking: compare against AirDNA market averages
- Alert thresholds: red/yellow/green ranges for each KPI
- KPI hierarchy: executive summary KPIs rolling up from business-level KPIs
- Summary report saved to ~/.openclaw/workspace/research/kpi-system-research.md

sessions.task: DESIGN: Rethink Mission Control Navigation & Information Architecture
sessions.description: Redesign Mission Control navigation to support the 10 command layers. Current sidebar reflects a tech platform dashboard — it needs to reflect an organizational operating system. Organize information, visualize relationships, surface insights, and reduce blind spots.

sessions.task: INFRA: Connect QuickBooks Data Pipeline for Finance Commands
sessions.description: Wire QuickBooks OAuth connection (already started) into Mission Control to power Revenue Command, Expense Command, and Cash Flow Command with real financial data. P&L, cash position, inflows/outflows, vendor spend all come from here.

sessions.task: RESEARCH: Digital Asset & DeFi Investment Tracking Framework for Capital Allocation Command
sessions.description:
USE EXA SEARCH to research and design a framework for tracking cryptocurrency holdings, DeFi positions, yield farming, staking rewards, and on-chain portfolio value. This feeds into CMD-6 (Investing & Capital Allocation).

EXA SEARCH QUERIES:
1. "cryptocurrency portfolio tracking tools 2026 DeFi"
